title: Convergence weeknote — Exec asks & All-team readiness v0.1
body:
Purpose

This note captures the convergent planning for the upcoming company-wide week: the executive update talking points, a compact OKR draft for cross-org alignment, the all-hands run-of-show, and a short risk/control register so leads can prepare mitigations. This is a working artifact: expect edits and inline comments. Primary audience: execs, team leads, communications, and the all-hands production crew.

Top-level goals for the week
- Align exec narrative on where Redwood is in product-market fit for inference economics and enterprise readiness.
- Get company-level commitment to three near-term operational bets (routing/fallback policy, Dedicated capacity expansion cadence, and Private deployment onboarding).
- Calibrate OKRs to measurable production outcomes and customer impact rather than purely platform features.
- Rehearse the all-hands flow and commit owners for comms and follow-ups.

Compact OKR draft (cross-functional, prioritized)
Objective A: Reduce per-query latency variance for hosted customers under normal load
- KR A1: 95th-percentile latency <= 180ms for text-gen across top 3 models (prod) by end of Q2 (owner: eng-serving-runtime)
- KR A2: Reduce cross-region failover time to < 2s for burst events (owner: platform-engineering)
- KR A3: Deliver prefix caching auto-tuning on production traffic for top-10 routes (owner: optimize)

Objective B: Make Dedicated capacity expansion predictable and profitable
- KR B1: Launch capacity reservation UI and billing flow (owner: product-dedicated)
- KR B2: Reach 80% utilization across reserved pools in 60-day trials with three pilot customers (owner: sales/solutions-eng)
- KR B3: Publish capacity-cost benchmarking docs and toolkit for customers (owner: developer-experience)

Objective C: Strengthen Private adoption for regulated enterprise workloads
- KR C1: Complete VPC private-control-plane beta with two pilot customers (owner: private-deployments)
- KR C2: Add KMS/HSM integration and audit-log retention controls to the private package (owner: security-and-compliance)
- KR C3: Create a customer onboarding playbook and training runbook (owner: solutions-engineering-and-professional-services)

Notes on the OKR draft
- These are intentionally outcome-focused (latency, utilization, pilots). Leads: refine KRs to metrics with measurement plans before finalization.
- Any team that feels their work is core to these objectives should add incremental KRs as child metrics and present at the post-all-hands sync.

Exec update talking points (concise bullets for CEO/CTO)
- Market: demand for predictable inference economics is increasing — we see enterprise RFIs moving from PoC to procurement with dedicated/reserved asks.
- Product: runtime improvements reduced median token cost by ~12% in last quarter; streaming reliability improved after the autoscaler changes.
- Operations: Dedicated capacity pilots are on track; three customers are in the procurement pipeline and one contract draft is near signature.
- Risk & mitigation: model divergence and hallucination regressions remain top risk for any model swap — daily evaluation harness checks will be mandatory for canary rollouts.
- Ask: Execs to approve (+$1.2M) runway reallocation to accelerate Private deployment engineering for two regulated pilot customers.

All-hands run-of-show (30–40 minute slot, including live Q&A)
- 00:00–02:00 (2m): Welcome & context — CEO (what we’re aligning on this week)
- 02:00–10:00 (8m): Product narrative — CTO (outcomes from runtime + roadmap bets)
- 10:00–18:00 (8m): Customer success highlight & Dedicated pilot story (CS + customer snippet)
- 18:00–25:00 (7m): People & ops update — hiring posture and capacity planning (People Ops + Finance)
- 25:00–35:00 (10m): Live Q&A with pre-seeded questions; final slide with 3 asks to the company
- 35:00–40:00 (5m): Close & next steps — Communications lead (where to find follow-up and how to volunteer for cross-team working groups)

Pre-seeded Qs for the panel (to prep)
- How will we support product teams when a model swap causes regression?
- What does success look like for Dedicated in the next 90 days?
- How do I sign up to help with Private deployment pilots or docs?

All-hands prep checklist (owners assigned)
- Slide deck final draft (owner: product) — due EOD two days before event.
- Rehearsal run-through (owner: comms + Exec EA) — schedule 48 hours prior.
- Live captions and recording test (owner: developer-experience) — run during rehearsal.
- Customer clip rights & redaction check (owner: customer-success) — clear by rehearsal.
- Slack Q&A channel & moderator roster (owner: comms) — identify 2 moderators.

Risk register (short)
- Risk: Model rollout causes increase in hallucinations for a core customer.
  - Trigger: Canary eval shows > 5% drop in pass-rate on safety prompts.
  - Mitigation: Immediate rollback + temporary routing to previous variant. Prepare one-click rollback and alerting (owner: serving-runtime).
- Risk: Dedicated capacity demand exceeds provisioning lead time.
  - Trigger: Sales closes 2 large pilots in same week.
  - Mitigation: Pre-authorize burst nodes from cloud partners and enable overflow routing to hosted with client consent (owner: platform-engineering + sales).
- Risk: Private pilot stalls on networking/KMS approvals.
  - Trigger: Legal/security checklist not cleared within 30 days.
  - Mitigation: Ship a trimmed proof-of-privacy package and assign an onboarding engineer from solutions (owner: private-deployments + security).

Decision log (for week)
- D1: Approve the three cross-org OKR objectives to be published as the company slate for the quarter (status: pending exec sign-off).
- D2: Approve runway reallocation ask ($1.2M) for Private pilot acceleration (status: requested — need finance + CEO).

Communications plan & channels
- Internal: post-event summary doc + recording in #all-hands and a follow-up 1-pager in Confluence.
- External (select): blog post with product outcomes + Dedicated pilot case study (timing: after pilot signatures).
- Volunteers: running cross-team working groups will be announced in the follow-up doc; teams should self-identify via the sign-up form (link in the post-event doc).

Rehearsal schedule (concrete)
- Wed 09:00–10:00 PT — Executive panel full run (video ON). Mandatory for presenters.
- Wed 10:30–11:00 PT — Tech check for streaming & captions (owner: dev-ex).
- Thu 08:30–09:00 PT — Dress rehearsal with Q&A moderator rehearsal (owner: comms).

Post-all-hands follow-ups (first 72 hours)
- Finalize OKR metrics & measurement plans (owners: respective leads) — due +3 business days.
- Publish recording + short action tracker (owner: comms) — due +1 business day.
- Kick off three cross-functional working groups and schedule first sprints (owners: initiative leads) — invites out +3 business days.

Open questions for execs to resolve this week
- Approve the runway reallocation and confirm finance constraints.
- Confirm measurement owner for latency KR (who will own instrumentation and dashboards).
- Decide whether we include a public-facing note about Dedicated pilot customers in the all-hands recording or keep it internal.

Appendix: quick links and assets to update before publishing (owners)
- OKR parent doc (Confluence) — product to update with final numeric KRs.
- All-hands deck (Drive) — product + comms to finalize.
- Rehearsal checklist (shared doc) — comms to maintain and close items.

If you want changes or to add an OKR candidate, edit this doc and tag @Priya. We'll merge final edits into the exec packet 24 hours before the all-hands.

-- Priya Shah (draft owner)
